papers.title: Color superconductors and holon metals from doping a Fractional Chern insulator
papers.abstract: We develop a unified framework for metallic and superconducting phases obtained by doping a fractional Chern insulator (FCI) with $C=1/3$. papers.title: Cosmological consequences of a dynamical dark matter in the light of DESI DR2 measurements
papers.abstract: Recent DESI results exhibit preference for a Null Energy Condition violating dynamical dark energy, with early phantom behaviour. We explore an alternative interpretation in which this preference arises from unconventional dark matter dynamics rather than from dynamical dark energy. papers.title: Theoretical uncertainties in reconstructing model parameters with gravitational waves from supercooled phase transitions
papers.abstract: Future interferometers may detect a gravitational-wave (GW) signal from a cosmological first-order phase transition. Reconstructing the underlying particle-physics model from such a signal requires theoretical control over the map from microphysics to the spectrum. papers.title: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
papers.abstract: Pretrained dense visual features from Vision Transformers (ViTs) are powerful yet have been underutilized in robot learning. Modern robot policies either compress each observation into a single global token, or rely on visual backbones trained from scratch, sacrificing both fine-grained spatial detail and the benefits of large-scale visual pre-training. papers.title: FM-VLA: Force-based Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models in Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved impressive generalization in robotic manipulation, and recent memory-augmented VLAs have relaxed the Markovian assumption by conditioning on past images or language summaries.
